# victorops_user_contact_phone (Resource)

Manages a phone contact method for a VictorOps user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "victorops_user_contact_phone" "jdane_mobile" {
  username = victorops_user.jdane.user_name
  phone    = "+1-555-123-4567"
  label    = "Mobile"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) A label for this phone contact (e.g., 'Work Phone', 'Mobile').
- `phone` (String) The phone number.
- `username` (String) The username of the user this contact phone belongs to.

### Optional

- `rank` (Number) The rank (priority) of this contact method.

### Read-Only

- `ext_id` (String) The external ID of the contact.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import victorops_user_contact_phone.jdane_mobile <username>/<ext_id>
```
